entities.summary: Jared Spurgeon is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman and captain for the Minnesota Wild of the National Hockey League (NHL). Spurgeon was selected 156th overall by the New York Islanders in the 2008 NHL entry draft but joined the Wild after going unsigned by the Islanders.
